name: madar-desk
description: Personal offline task management for Windows

scripts.dist:rc: python scripts/ensure_new_release.py Madar-Desk-v1.0-rc13-rial-ledger-preview-20261022.exe && npm run build && python -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --onefile --windowed --name Madar-Desk-v1.0-rc13-rial-ledger-preview-20261022 --icon assets/madar.ico --distpath release --workpath .build-pyinstaller --specpath . --add-data "dist;dist" native_app.py
